name: Vampire - Unarmed Strike - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a legendary

results.text: The vampire's crimson eyes narrow as he coils like a serpent preparing to strike.
With a chilling hiss, the undead predator launches into the fray with terrifying speed.
His fangs glint in the moonlight as he raises his clawed hands for a devastating blow.
A shadowy aura swirls around him as he prepares to unleash his legendary fury.
The air grows heavy with the scent of decay as he readies his unholy attack.
